questions.q_en: In a circle, chord AB and chord CD intersect each other at E such that AE : EB=2:3 and CE : ED=5:2. If AB=x and CD=y, which of the following is correct?
questions.q_hi: एक वृत्त में, जीवा AB और जीवा CD एक-दूसरे को बिंदु E पर इस प्रकार काटती हैं कि AE : EB = 2 : 3 और CE : ED = 5 : 2 है। यदि AB = x और CD = y हो, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
options_en: x²/y² = 15/16
x/y = 10/9
x/y = 6/15
x²/y² = 125/147
options_hi: x²/y² = 15/16
x/y = 10/9
x/y = 6/15
x²/y² = 125/147
questions.solution_en:
By Using Property
AE × EB = CE × ED

AB = 5 unit = N
AE = 2 unit = 2x/5
EB = 3 unit = 3x/5
CD = 7 unit = y
CE = 5 unit = 5y/7
ED = 2 unit = 2y/7

Putting these values:
(2x/5) × (3x/5) = (5y/7) × (2y/7)
x²/y² = 125/147
questions.solution_hi:
गुणधर्म का उपयोग करने पर:

AE × EB = CE × ED

AB = 5 इकाई = N

AE = 2 इकाई = 2x/5

EB = 3 इकाई = 3x/5

CD = 7 इकाई = y

CE = 5 इकाई = 5y/7

ED = 2 इकाई = 2y/7

इन मानों को रखने पर:

(2x/5) × (3x/5) = (5y/7) × (2y/7)

x²/y² = 125/147

questions.q_en: An equilateral triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with centre O. D is a point on the minor arc BC and CBD = 40°. Find the measure of BCD.
questions.q_hi: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज ABC को केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त के अंतर्गत बनाया गया है। D लघु चाप BC पर एक बिंदु है तथा CBD = 40° है। BCD का माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
options_en: 30°
50°
20°
40°
questions.solution_en:
Given, △ABC is an equilateral △,
∠CBD = 40 ̊
∵△ ABC is equilateral then ∠A = ∠B = ∠C= 60 ̊
So, ∠A + ∠D =180 ̊ [cyclic]
∠D =180 ̊ - 60 ̊ = 120 ̊

Now in triangle BCD;

40 ̊ + 120 ̊ + ∠BCD = 180 ̊,

∠BCD = 20 ̊
questions.solution_hi:
दिया गया है, △ABC एक समबाहु △ है,
∠CBD = 40 ̊
∵△ ABC समबाहु है तो ∠A = ∠B = ∠C= 60 ̊
तो, ∠A + ∠D =180 ̊ [चक्रीय]
∠D =180 ̊ - 60 ̊ = 120 ̊

अब △BCD में;

40 ̊ + 120 ̊ + ∠BCD = 180 ̊,

∠BCD = 20 ̊

questions.q_en: In ABC, D is a point on side BC such that ADC = 2BAD. If A = 80° and C = 38°, then what is the measure of ADB?
questions.q_hi: ABC में, D भुजा BC पर एक बिंदु है इस प्रकार कि ADC = 2 BAD है। यदि A = 80° और C = 38° है, तो ADB का माप क्या है?
options_en:
52°

    56°

    58°    

    62°
options_hi:
52°

56°

58°

62°
questions.solution_en:
Given that
∠ADC = 2∠BAD
∠A = 80°, ∠C = 38°
Let ∠BAD = θ ̊, then ∠ADC = 2θ ̊
So, ∠ABD = 2θ θ [Exterior angle]
∠ABD = θ ̊
Now; in △ABC
θ + 80 + 38 = 180 ̊
θ =180 - 118 = 62 ̊
Now; in △ABD
2θ + ∠ADB = 180 ̊
∠ADB = 180 – 2 × 62
=180 124
∠ADB = 56 ̊
questions.solution_hi:
मान लें कि
∠ADC = 2∠BAD
∠A = 80°, ∠C = 38°
माना ∠BAD = θ ̊, तो ∠ADC = 2θ ̊
तो, ∠ABD = 2θ - θ [बाहरी कोण]
∠ABD = θ ̊
अब; △ ABC में
θ + 80 + 38 = 180 ̊
θ =180 -118 = 62 ̊
अब; △ABD में
2θ + ∠ADB = 180 ̊
∠ADB = 180 – 2 × 62
=180 -124
∠ADB = 56 ̊
